item.title: Here Are All the Key Dates for the 2027 Golden Globes
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest updates from the world of entertainment. Today, we're talking about the Golden Globes. The 84th Annual Golden Globes has released its full awards timetable, and we've got the details.
[Music transitions to a smooth, engaging tune]
Host: The ceremony is set to broadcast live from the Beverly Hilton Hotel in Beverly Hills, California, on Sunday, January 10th, 2027, on CBS and streaming on Paramount+ in the US. And, for the third year in a row, comedian Nikki Glaser will be hosting the show.
Let's take a look back at the 2026 Golden Globes. The film "One Battle After Another" took home four awards, the most of any film, and later went on to win the Oscar for Best Picture. On the TV side, "Adolescence" was the top winner, also with four awards.
[Music transitions to a short, informational theme]
Host: Now, let's dive into the important dates for the upcoming Golden Globes. Submissions open on June 1st, and the deadline for motion picture, television, and podcast submissions is October 30th. Nominations will be announced on December 7th.
Here are the key dates to keep in mind:
* June 1st: Submission website opens * October 30th: Deadline for submissions * November 16th: Television and podcast nomination ballots are sent to voters * November 22nd: Final date for television and podcast press conferences and program uploads * December 7th: Nominations are announced
[Music transitions to an outro theme]
Host: That's all for today. The Golden Globes is indeed "Hollywood's Party of the Year," celebrating the best of film, television, and podcasting. We'll be keeping an eye on the upcoming awards season, so stay tuned for more updates.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!
